directive_events.owner_directive: Q1 unified candidates: legacy previewers compete in the same ladder as panels (FR-006/007); legacy renders only when a legacy candidate wins; legacy never holds or installs panels.

Q2: page-file changes reload in place for all context kinds via a panel-level files-changed mechanism (backend watch per open panel, frontend debounce in PanelFrame, MiniAppTab copy removed); panel.json descriptor changes invalidate contexts using that panel incl. MiniApps; answers.json, .answers-*, __pycache__, dotfiles, node_modules ignored in fingerprints.
Q3-a: new WS event panel.contexts_revoked {context_ids, panel_ids, reason} in the ws outbound allowlist; frontend handles only affected mounts.
Q3-y: when a preview panel is added/changed/removed, open previews re-route immediately, only those whose data type (type chain + Collection-ness) is affected by the changed panels' declared types.

Q5-b: when legacy previewers are reloaded as a whole (Reload, package install, project switch), every legacy-rendered preview remounts and recreates its session; panel-rendered previews, interactive and MiniApp contexts untouched.
Q6-b: previewer choices PUT/DELETE update choices in PanelService (persisted) without refresh_all_registries; emit panel.choices_changed {type}; only open previews of that type switch.
Q7: panel-routed preview sessions are split out of the legacy PreviewSessionManager in this PR.

Q8: panel discovery has one implementation in scistudio.panels used by PanelService and block interactive panel validation; blocks must not depend on api; changes under src/scistudio/blocks/** not authorised.
blocks.reloaded keeps working for block catalog and MiniApp list; frontend must not invalidate the previewer catalog or remount previews on it unless the payload says preview candidates changed.
Project switch closes all panel contexts and ends MiniApp processes immediately; same-project reopen does not close.

Delete install_panels coupling, PreviewService.panel_sources, PANEL branch in legacy session manager, panels/catalog_refresh.py, workflow_watcher panel hook, PanelContext.preview_service identity check, legacy PreviewRouter duplication; refresh_all_registries = types, blocks, legacy.rebuild, panel_service.rescan.
No documentation edits in this PR (owner is revising docs); docs N/A, stale doc mentions listed in the PR body.
